description: Bind all 12 module route screens to their generated hooks using the FEAT-001 foundation (ResourceTable, PageHeader, StatusBadge, state components, useCurrentStudy), refactor studies.tsx onto the shared components, and delete the now-unused module-placeholder. Depends on FEAT-001 (does not build without ResourceTable/PageHeader/useCurrentStudy). Covers raw/sdtm/adam/tlf (3-positional aggregate hooks), documents/review/integrations (2-positional array hooks), standards/terminology/validation (tabbed global+scoped), packaging (artifacts, 3-positional, no package-list API), and reconciliation (special lookup-by-id, no list hook). Grounded in design.md 'Per-screen design' sections 1-12.
steps: raw/sdtm/adam/tlf (src/routes/_app/raw.tsx, sdtm.tsx, adam.tsx, tlf.tsx): each reads `const { currentStudyId, isLoading: studiesLoading } = useCurrentStudy()`, calls the 3-POSITIONAL hook `useListXxxAggregates(currentStudyId ?? '', undefined, { query: { enabled: !!currentStudyId } })`, normalizes rows `data?.items ?? []`, renders PageHeader + ResourceTable (getRowId row=>row.id, error passed through, resourceLabel e.g. 'raw datasets'). Columns: raw = code,name,document_type(cell -> value ?? '—'),status(StatusBadge),revision; sdtm/adam/tlf = code,name,status(StatusBadge),revision. Pass ResourceTable emptyState = <EmptyState title='No study selected' description='Create a study first to view its {resource}.'/> for the no-study case.

documents/review/integrations (src/routes/_app/documents.tsx, review.tsx, integrations.tsx): each uses the 2-POSITIONAL hook `useListXxx(currentStudyId ?? '', { query: { enabled: !!currentStudyId } })`, rows `data ?? []`. documents cols: document_code,name,document_type,status(StatusBadge),revision,updated_at(formatDate). review cols: target_module,target_entity_type,question(truncate via a max-w + truncate className),priority(StatusBadge),status(StatusBadge),updated_at(formatDate). integrations cols: integration_code,display_name,direction,status(StatusBadge),revision,updated_at(formatDate). Same no-study emptyState.

standards (src/routes/_app/standards.tsx): tabbed layout (Tabs primitive) with three tabs, each its own ResourceTable+hook. Products: useListStandards(), rows data ?? [], cols code,name,provider,family,product_type,scope. Terminology releases: useListReleases(), cols code,version,provider,product,lifecycle(StatusBadge),content_schema_version. Templates: useListTemplates(), cols code,name. Header 'Standards catalog'. Global — no study gating.

terminology (src/routes/_app/terminology.tsx): tabbed. Releases tab: useListReleases() (same cols as Standards releases tab). Study extensions tab (2-positional): useListExtensions(currentStudyId ?? '', { query: { enabled: !!currentStudyId } }), rows data ?? [], cols code,name,codelist_code,status(StatusBadge),revision; use the no-study emptyState. useListCodelists is intentionally NOT wired. Header 'Terminology'.

validation (src/routes/_app/validation.tsx): tabbed. Rules tab: useListRules(), cols rule_id,version,module_key,default_severity(StatusBadge),mandatory(cell -> Yes/No). Platform rule packs tab: useListPlatformRulePacks(), cols code,name,lifecycle(StatusBadge),revision,updated_at(formatDate). Study rule packs tab (2-positional): useListStudyRulePacks(currentStudyId ?? '', { query: { enabled: !!currentStudyId } }), same cols as platform packs; no-study emptyState. Header 'Validation'.

packaging (src/routes/_app/packaging.tsx): 3-POSITIONAL `useListArtifacts(currentStudyId ?? '', undefined, { query: { enabled: !!currentStudyId } })`, rows data?.items ?? []. Cols module,artifact_type,filename,media_type,size(className 'text-right', cell formatBytes),status(StatusBadge),created_at(formatDate). PageHeader title 'Submission artifacts' with a description noting these are generated artifacts available for packaging (no package-list API yet). No-study emptyState.

reconciliation (src/routes/_app/reconciliation.tsx): SPECIAL lookup-by-id (no list hook). Controlled Input + 'Look up' Button; on submit set runId state to the trimmed value; Button disabled when trimmed value empty. Queries: useGetReconciliation(runId, { query: { enabled: !!runId } }) and useListReconciliationIssues(runId, { query: { enabled: !!runId } }). Before lookup -> <EmptyState title=... description='Enter a reconciliation run id to view its result.'/>. On loaded run -> summary Card (reconciliation_type, reconciliation_version, status via StatusBadge, error_count/warning_count/info_count, started_at/completed_at via formatDate) + issues ResourceTable. Issue columns = union of keys `Array.from(new Set(issues.flatMap((i) => Object.keys(i))))`; cell `const v = (issue as Record<string, unknown>)[key]; return v == null ? '—' : typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)`; ONLY when the union is empty use a single synthetic 'raw' column rendering JSON.stringify(issue); getRowId = (_, index) pattern i.e. map rows with a stable index-derived id (String(index)). Header 'Reconciliation'.
Refactor src/routes/_app/studies.tsx to use PageHeader + StatusBadge (remove the inline statusVariant), keeping its card-grid layout and data behavior unchanged.
Delete src/components/layout/module-placeholder.tsx after confirming (grep/search) no route or component still imports it.
acceptance_criteria: All 12 route files under src/routes/_app/ (raw, documents, sdtm, adam, tlf, standards, terminology, validation, reconciliation, review, packaging, integrations) render real screens with no remaining import of ModulePlaceholder.

Each aggregate/artifact hook call passes `undefined` as the params argument so the options object reaches the correct (last positional) slot; each scoped query is gated with `enabled: !!currentStudyId`.
src/components/layout/module-placeholder.tsx is deleted and no import of it remains anywhere.
studies.tsx uses PageHeader + StatusBadge and still renders its study cards.
`npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) completes with zero TypeScript errors.
No file under src/api/generated/** and not src/routeTree.gen.ts was modified; the _app beforeLoad guard is unchanged; dashboard, studies, and login/signup pages still render.
verification: From frontend/: run `npm run build` and confirm zero type errors.
From frontend/: run `npm run lint` and confirm zero errors.
Search the repo for 'module-placeholder' and 'ModulePlaceholder' and confirm zero remaining references.
Confirm via git diff that no src/api/generated/** file and not src/routeTree.gen.ts changed and src/routes/_app.tsx beforeLoad guard is intact.
findings:
All 12 module route screens wired and verified. npm run build (tsc -b && vite build): 0 type errors; npm run lint: 0 errors (only the 3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings in badge.tsx/button.tsx/sidebar.tsx). No src/api/generated/** file was edited and src/routes/_app.tsx beforeLoad guard is unchanged. src/components/layout/module-placeholder.tsx deleted; zero 'ModulePlaceholder'/'module-placeholder' references remain.

Hook arity verified against generated sources and applied: 3-positional with undefined params -> useListRawAggregates/useListSdtmAggregates/useListAdamAggregates/useListTlfAggregates (raw/sdtm/adam/tlf.tsx), useListArtifacts (packaging.tsx); 2-positional (studyId, options) -> useListDocuments/useListReviewItems/useListIntegrations (documents/review/integrations.tsx), useListExtensions (terminology.tsx extensions tab), useListStudyRulePacks (validation.tsx study tab); global options-only -> useListStandards/useListReleases/useListTemplates (standards.tsx), useListRules/useListPlatformRulePacks (validation.tsx), useListReleases (terminology.tsx releases tab). Reconciliation is lookup-by-id: useGetReconciliation + useListReconciliationIssues gated on a trimmed runId state; issues table derives columns from the union of keys (Array.from(new Set(issues.flatMap(Object.keys)))) with a synthetic 'raw' JSON column only when the union is empty. Collections normalized data?.items ?? []; arrays normalized data ?? [].

Notes for integration: studies.tsx already used PageHeader + StatusBadge (migrated in FEAT-001) with no inline statusVariant, so no further refactor was needed. Reconciliation getRowId uses issueRows.indexOf(row) because ResourceTable's getRowId is single-arg (row only), not (row, index); the two reconciliation queries share one ResourceTable error via run.error ?? issues.error. Tabbed screens (standards/terminology/validation) split each tab into its own child component so each hook runs in its own component and inactive tabs still mount/cache per design.
